name: Holo UI Vault — Unified Dual-Dimension Index
description: Agent-First bidirectional index connecting design styles, component functions, concrete file locations, and harmonization rules. Optimized for low-token, zero-ambiguity retrieval.

rules: DO NOT read beautifului-components/index.html (32KB human visual preview, wastes tokens).
DO NOT recursively scan directories. Retrieve only the exact snippet or token file needed.
Single-task retrieval budget: maximum 1 snippet file + 1 shared CSS file.

ai_native_productivity.name: AI-Native Productivity (Source: Beautiful UI)
ai_native_productivity.aesthetic: Cold neutral, dark-first, high information density, 0.5px hairlines, tabular figures, subtle shimmer transitions.
when_to_use: LLM reasoning and thinking chain display (thinking-state)
Agent tool call and file modification chips (tool-chips)
AI SaaS, agent dashboards, terminal/CLI-inspired web apps
when_not_to_use: Generic ecommerce stores, landing pages, children apps, casual mobile games

apple_human_interface.name: Apple Human Interface (Source: Apple HIG)
apple_human_interface.aesthetic: Humanist, tactile spatial depth, continuous squircle curvature, liquid glass blur, spring physics, 44pt touch friendliness.
when_to_use: Consumer-facing applications, mobile web apps and PWAs
System settings, preference panels, grouped form lists
Contextual overlays: Action Sheets, Bottom Sheets, Alerts
Tactile card layouts with soft shadows and inner specular highlights
Interfaces prioritizing readability, visual breathing room, and accessibility
when_not_to_use: Ultra-dense financial ticker screens, raw hacker CLI terminals

ai_reasoning_and_states.description: Visual indicators for AI processing, reasoning, and token generation.

items.recommended_when: General AI processing without granular step-by-step reasoning.
LLM emits step-by-step reasoning, tool call logs, or chain-of-thought.
Real-time token streaming with inline sources and action toolbars.

inputs_and_prompts.description: User message composers, prompt bars, and search inputs.

items.recommended_when: Single-line or expanding AI prompt input with model selector and attachments.
Full conversational panel with tab switching and message history.
Quick command palette modal with keyboard shortcut indicator.

human_in_the_loop_and_tools.description: User permission gates, action approval, and agent tool execution logs.

items.recommended_when: Agent requires explicit human confirmation before executing high-risk actions.
Tracking multi-step agent execution progress with running, completed, and failed states.
Displaying file edits, external API calls, and line counts compactly.
Contextual floating toolbar appearing above highlighted text.

data_and_diff.description: Tabular records, status filtering, and version comparison.

items.recommended_when: Displaying before/after data changes proposed by an agent.
Complex CRM/database view with sticky columns, tags, and calculations.
Task and issue tracking tables with status badges (Todo, Progress, Done).

cards_and_knowledge.description: RAG chunk previews, metric insights, and suggestions.

items.recommended_when: Agent proactive suggestion with confidence meter and alternative choices.
RAG retrieval chunk display with file badges and character counts.
Time-series chart with crosshair tracker, delta percentage, and tooltip.
Model hyperparameter adjustment controls (temperature, top_p).

navigation_and_presentation.description: Structural sidebars, workflow graphs, and virtual viewports.

items.recommended_when: Collapsible application sidebar with workspace switcher.
Branching decision trees and multi-step agent execution graphs.
Dark-themed code viewer with title bar, line numbers, and copy action.
Demonstrating computer-use agents driving a virtual browser.

style_harmonization.principle: Beautiful UI provides interaction skeletons; Apple HIG provides visual tokens and physics. They can be seamlessly blended without conflict.
rules: When embedding Beautiful UI components into an Apple-themed project, map container radii to var(--apple-radius-lg) or var(--apple-radius-xl).
Replace dark solid surfaces with Apple Liquid Glass material: background: var(--apple-material-regular); backdrop-filter: var(--apple-blur-regular);
Ensure all clickable elements satisfy the Apple 44pt minimum touch boundary.
Adopt Apple Spring curve: transition-timing-function: var(--apple-ease-spring);
Maintain a single primary style hierarchy per viewport. Do not mix sharp brutalist elements with soft squircles.
